meta.name: hunt-fintech-graphql
meta.description: Hunt fintech-specific GraphQL vulnerabilities: money-movement mutations (transfers, redemptions, withdrawals, card top-ups), ledger/balance/portfolio query IDOR, decimal-precision and rounding abuse, idempotency-key bypass enabling double-spend, KYC/PII field-level authorization gaps, and admin-override mutations reachable via mass assignment. Distinct from hunt-graphql, which owns generic GraphQL discovery and IDOR/mutation methodology — this skill owns the delta introduced when a GraphQL layer sits in front of a ledger, wallet, payments, banking, brokerage, or lending backend, where a resolver bug moves real money instead of just leaking data. Use when hunting a fintech, banking, payments, wallet, neobank, brokerage, or lending target that exposes a GraphQL API, or when a schema/response includes balance, transfer, ledger, redeem, quote, KYC, or account-linking fields.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现金融应用中资金操作与账户信息的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在测试金融系统接口，担心转账、提现等环节有安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Find security flaws in fintech apps' money-moving operations and account data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you test financial APIs and worry about vulnerabilities in transfers and account data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在检查金融类 GraphQL 接口时，会专门寻找资金流动相关漏洞：重复转账、金额小数位被利用、越权操作他人账户、敏感金融信息泄露等，并会按步骤构造测试请求验证是否真的发生资金变动。
howto.when: 当目标提供金融科技、银行、支付等行业的 GraphQL 接口，或数据中包含 balance、transfer、ledger 等金融相关字段时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 GraphQL 转账接口能否用同一幂等键重复发起交易。
say.note: Claude 会重放请求，看是否产生两笔交易。

say.text: 测试转账金额传 `0.001`、`-50.00` 或超大数，看服务端如何处理。
say.note: Claude 会发送边界值，检查舍入和精度漏洞。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will hunt fintech GraphQL money-movement bugs: replay idempotency keys, test decimal/rounding edges, probe cross-account transfer IDOR, and check KYC/PII field auth, using provided payloads to confirm ledger changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when targeting fintech, banking, or payments GraphQL APIs, or when schema/response includes balance, transfer, ledger fields.

say_en.text: Check if this GraphQL transfer endpoint accepts a replayed idempotency key.
say_en.note: Claude replays it to see if two transactions occur.

say_en.text: Test transfer amounts like `0.001`, `-50.00`, or huge numbers for server handling.
say_en.note: Claude sends edge values to check rounding and precision bugs.

say_en.text: In a transaction query, request counterparty's ssnLast4 and routingNumber fields.
say_en.note: Claude checks if field-level authorization is missing.
